content.text: {"story":{"as_a":"user who manages my personal task list","i_want":"to update an existing task's fields in an edit form","so_that":"my task list stays accurate after plans change","business_description":"Users can change an existing task through the shared task form in edit mode. The backend validates the changed values, stores them, and refreshes the Last Updated Date. The frontend shows a success or error message and never shows an update as saved before the backend confirms it.","business_value":"Keeps task data current without deleting and recreating tasks, and gives users a clear success or error result for every edit.","acceptance_criteria":[{"given":"Given an existing task with a valid title and a Due Date not earlier than its Creation Date","when":"When the user opens the edit form, changes the title, and submits the form","then":"Then the backend stores the new title, sets the Last Updated Date to the time of the update, and the task shows the new title in the list after the backend returns success"},{"given":"Given an existing task with a valid title, description, priority, status and Due Date","when":"When the user changes the description, priority, status and Due Date to other allowed values and submits the form","then":"Then the backend stores each changed value and the frontend displays a success message after the backend returns success"},{"given":"Given an existing task being edited in the form","when":"When the user clears the title field and submits the form","then":"Then the backend rejects the update, the task keeps its previous title, and an error message stating that the title is mandatory is shown"},{"given":"Given an existing task with Creation Date 2024-05-10","when":"When the user sets the Due Date to 2024-05-09 and submits the update","then":"Then the backend rejects the update with a validation error, the stored Due Date is unchanged, and an error message is shown"},{"given":"Given an existing task with a title of 100 characters","when":"When the user changes the title to 101 characters and submits the update","then":"Then the backend rejects the update with a validation error, the stored title is unchanged, and an error message stating that the title must be 100 characters or fewer is shown"},{"given":"Given a task update request where the backend returns an error","when":"When the frontend receives the error response","then":"Then the frontend does not show the task as updated and displays an error message"},{"given":"Given a task update request where the backend returns success","when":"When the frontend receives the success response","then":"Then the frontend displays a success message after the update action"},{"given":"Given a task ID that does not exist in the database","when":"When an update request is sent for that ID","then":"Then the backend returns a Task Not Found error and no data is changed"},{"given":"Given an existing task with a Last Updated Date of 2024-05-10 10:00:00 UTC","when":"When an update request for that task is rejected by validation","then":"Then the Last Updated Date remains 2024-05-10 10:00:00 UTC"}],"edge_cases":["The Due Date may equal the Creation Date, because the rule only rejects dates earlier than the Creation Date.","A title made of spaces only: the PRD requires a non-empty title but does not say whether whitespace counts as empty. Open question.","Setting status to Completed through the edit form: the PRD says Completion Date is populated when a task is completed, but does not say whether the edit form path sets it. Open question.","A status or priority value outside the allowed values (Open, In Progress, Completed; Low, Medium, High) is rejected as invalid input.","An update request for a task deleted by another user session returns Task Not Found and no data is changed.","Editing only the fields the user changed or sending the full task is not specified in the PRD. The backend must handle both without changing unchanged fields. Open question on the request shape."],"dependencies":["US-create-task"],"definition_of_done":["The backend update endpoint for a task by ID accepts title, description, priority, status and Due Date, and rejects values outside the allowed sets.","The backend rejects an empty title, a title longer than 100 characters, and a Due Date earlier than the Creation Date with a validation error.","The backend sets Last Updated Date on every successful update and leaves it unchanged on a failed update.","The backend returns Task Not Found for an unknown task ID and changes no data.","The edit form reuses the task creation form with existing values pre-filled.","The frontend shows a success message only after a success response and an error message after an error response, with no optimistic update.","Automated tests cover each acceptance criterion."]},"tasks":[{"key_slug":"update-task-endpoint","title":"[BE] Add update endpoint for a task by ID with validation and Last Updated Date","track":"backend","area":"backend","description":"Add an endpoint that updates an existing task by ID. Validate title (non-empty, max 100 characters), Due Date (not earlier than Creation Date), and allowed values for status and priority. On success, set Last Updated Date to the time of the update. On failure, change no stored data. Return Task Not Found for unknown IDs, and the error responses defined for invalid input, missing mandatory fields, and internal or database errors.","size":"M","consumes_api":false,"touches_db":true,"requirement_ids":["R-bc3213df","R-03df7815","R-efe1e5d4","R-0b1853d6","R-244669c0","R-9dc414dc"],"is_spike":false,"definition_of_done":["Endpoint updates title, description, priority, status and Due Date of an existing task by ID.","Validation errors for empty title, title longer than 100 characters, and Due Date earlier than Creation Date return no stored change.","Last Updated Date is set on every successful update and unchanged on failure.","Unknown task ID returns Task Not Found and changes no data.","Error responses for invalid input and internal or database errors follow the shared simple error format."]},{"key_slug":"task-edit-form","title":"[FE] Reuse task form in edit mode with existing values pre-filled","track":"frontend","area":"frontend","description":"Reuse the task creation form in edit mode. Pre-fill all editable fields from the current task, submit changes to the update endpoint, and show the success or error message returned by the backend. Do not show the task as updated before the backend confirms the change.","size":"M","consumes_api":true,"touches_db":false,"requirement_ids":["R-9b30a145","R-d57336f7","R-03df7815","R-efe1e5d4","R-0b1853d6"],"is_spike":false,"definition_of_done":["Edit mode opens with title, description, priority, status and Due Date pre-filled from the task.","Client-side checks show the same title and Due Date messages as the backend.","Success message shows only after a success response; error message shows after an error response.","No optimistic update: the list and form show the old value until the backend confirms."]},{"key_slug":"task-update-test-suite","title":"[QA] Test suite for editing an existing task across API and form","track":"qa_general","area":"qa","description":"Automated tests for the update flow: API validation and error responses, stored values and Last Updated Date, and the edit form behaviour including success and error messages and no optimistic update.","size":"S","consumes_api":true,"touches_db":false,"requirement_ids":[],"derived_reason":"testing","is_spike":false,"definition_of_done":["Tests cover every acceptance criterion of the story.","Tests verify Last Updated Date changes on success and does not change on failure.","Tests verify the form shows no success state when the backend returns an error.","Tests run in the team's CI pipeline and pass."]}]}
